map.ASCVD 一级预防风险评估：结合年龄、血压、血脂、吸烟、糖尿病等估算 10 年: ASCVD primary prevention risk assessment: combines age, blood pressure, lipids, smoking and diabetes to estimate the 10-year risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease; the higher the risk, the greater the net benefit of primary prevention.
map.→ 打开阿司匹林(一级预防)获益风险评估器工具: -> Open the aspirin (primary prevention) benefit-risk evaluator tool
map.一级预防常用剂量多少？: What dose is normally used for primary prevention?
map.不是。一级预防（无心血管病）仅对 10 年风险高且出血风险低的部分中老年患者可能: No. Primary prevention (with no cardiovascular disease) may benefit only some middle-aged and older patients whose 10-year risk is high and bleeding risk low; those aged 60 or above, or with high bleeding risk, are generally not recommended. For secondary prevention populations such as those with a prior myocardial infarction or stent, long-term use is usual, following medical advice.
map.依据USPSTF 2022及ACC/AHA指南，评估阿司匹林用于心血管病一级预防: Evaluates the benefit and bleeding risk of aspirin for primary prevention of cardiovascular disease, following the USPSTF 2022 and ACC/AHA guidelines
map.出血风险权衡：用年龄、消化道出血史、合用抗凝/NSAID、幽门螺杆菌感染等评估胃: Bleeding risk trade-off: use age, history of gastrointestinal bleeding, concomitant anticoagulants or NSAIDs and Helicobacter pylori infection to assess gastrointestinal and intracranial bleeding risk; those at high bleeding risk do not take aspirin routinely.
map.吃阿司匹林要注意什么？: What should be watched when taking aspirin?
map.多为肠溶阿司匹林 75–100 mg/日。剂量过低预防效果不足，过高出血风险上升: Usually enteric-coated aspirin 75-100 mg per day. Too low a dose gives inadequate prevention and too high a dose raises bleeding risk. Whether to take it and for how long should be decided by a doctor based on risk factors and bleeding history; do not buy and take it on your own.
map.年龄与性别阈值（参考 USPSTF 2022）：40–59 岁、10 年 CVD: Age and sex thresholds (referring to USPSTF 2022): people aged 40-59 with a 10-year CVD risk of 10% or above and low bleeding risk may be considered individually; at 60 and above the net benefit of primary prevention falls (bleeding risk rises) and initiation is generally not recommended.
map.心梗 TIMI 危险分层（STEMI 30天死亡风险）: Myocardial infarction TIMI risk stratification (30-day mortality in STEMI)
map.房颤 CHA₂DS₂-VASc 栓塞风险评估器: Atrial fibrillation CHA2DS2-VASc thromboembolic risk assessor
map.所有人都能吃阿司匹林预防吗？: Can everyone take aspirin for prevention?
map.留意黑便、牙龈出血、瘀斑、胃痛等出血信号；避免与布洛芬等 NSAID 长期同服；: Watch for signs of bleeding such as black stool, gum bleeding, bruising and stomach pain; avoid long-term co-administration with NSAIDs such as ibuprofen; tell your doctor before surgery or a tooth extraction so they can decide whether to pause it. If there is a history of peptic ulcer, eradicate Helicobacter pylori first and protect the stomach.
map.高血压 JNC 分级与风险分层: Hypertension JNC grading and risk stratification
map.默认数据演练（55 岁男性一级预防评估）: Walkthrough with default data (primary prevention assessment of a 55-year-old male)
map.：输入：男、55 岁、收缩压 148 mmHg、LDL-C 3.6 mmol/L: : entered: male, 55 years old, systolic 148 mmHg, LDL-C 3.6 mmol/L, smoker, no diabetes, no history of gastrointestinal bleeding. The tool outputs a 10-year ASCVD risk of about 14% (10% or above), bleeding risk low, net benefit positive, and a recommendation that low-dose aspirin (75-100 mg/day) may be considered after medical assessment, together with blood pressure and lipid control. Note that the final judgement must come from a clinician.
